description: Gift rooms session (SPEC 18): RoomClient traces with a scripted socket, a scripted token provider, a fake clock and a scripted random source. Format: conformance/README.md.

scenarios.name: join: token, socket with gs.v1 + token, hello, welcome, live gifts, viewers, own gift skipped, leave

steps.name: the token user's own gift (claim u = me) is not played again
frames and closes of a left socket change nothing

scenarios.name: drop: first retry random 0-5 s, hello with last, replay played once (dedup) and flagged
backoff grows with failures in a row and resets after 60 s open

steps.name: open 59,999 ms: not stable, the counter keeps growing
open 60 s: the counter restarts (first drop: random 0-5 s)

scenarios.name: 4001 token expired: forceRefresh, reconnect at once with last
4001 right at connect, twice: the second retry backs off
refresh ahead of welcome.ttl (30 s before), and never later than the 60 minute lifetime
ttl of 30 s or less: no early refresh, the server's 4001 does it
heartbeat: ping after 45 s without frames, any frame counts, no answer in 10 s reconnects
heartbeatMs 0 (native protocol pings): never sends ping
no welcome within 10 s of opening the socket: reconnect
4003 forbidden: closed for good
4009 replaced: closed for good
room full: retry after 30 s, at most 5 times in a row
pause (background) closes and keeps last; resume reconnects with it; a token that arrives while paused opens nothing
reconnectNow (network back) skips the wait
getToken fails: retried like a dropped connection
a bad room id closes with 4004 without asking for a token
the user option wins over the token's u claim
skipOwn false: the token user's gifts play too
batch: every event goes through the filter
batch then drop: a collapsed gift plays once with its summed quantity, hello.last = id of the batch's last gift
getToken never answers: after 20 s the attempt counts as failed, a late answer is ignored
12 failed attempts in a row: closed with retries_exhausted; reconnectNow starts again with a fresh budget
4011 project suspended: closed without retry; reconnectNow starts again; a final 4003 stays closed
reconnectNow never skips a 4008 wait; the wait ends on its own (random 0.5: 60 s + 25 % jitter)
reconnectNow never skips a 4009 room-full wait either; a later 1006 wait can be skipped again
4008 with retry_after: the wait doubles up to 5 minutes and the session never ends
4008 with retry_after 60 and random 0.5: 25 % jitter on the first wait
random 0 never gives a zero wait: the floor is 500 ms
refresh jitter: refreshJitterMs 120,000 and random 0.5 refresh 60 s earlier than ttl - 30 s
refresh jitter never exceeds half of what is left: ttl 90 s, random 0.999
